intro: Return the Comb is an Alliance errand in Duskwood that concludes the haunting transaction with the spirit Blind Mary. After being presented with a comb to harvest strands of her spectral hair, the tortured ghost is overcome with despair over her lost beauty and casts the implement away. Returning the hair-laden comb to Madame Eva allows the mystic to spin the ethereal Ghost Hair Thread.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Take it, take this comb away from me!
I'm a monster, and no one will ever think me lovely again!

clips.title: Progress
paras: I sense that you have seen Blind Mary. You have my Comb...?

clips.title: Completion
paras: I can make a spool of Ghost Hair Thread with this, and have a few strands to spare. Here are some coins for those extra strands.
